files.README.md:
# Gorsewick Studios - standup follow-ups

The standup bot appends its notes to minutes/ as plain bullets, one per line,
no header. Producers collect the follow-ups into followups/, one file per
standup day named YYYY-MM-DD.md.

A follow-up file lists only action items: a bullet counts as an action item
when it names an owner and carries a due date. Each line is written as

    - <name>: <one-line summary> (due <date>)

in the order the bullets appear in the notes.

When you are done, describe in two or three sentences what you wrote.
